# Pouya Mansournia

> Experimental navigation aid for language-model tools. This file is not required by Google and does not guarantee ranking, indexing, AI Overview inclusion, or citation.

Pouya Mansournia is a robotics systems architect, mechatronics engineer, and founder working across autonomous mobile robots, warehouse automation, embedded systems, precision mechanisms, product management, innovation, AI-assisted product development, and industrial automation. His work connects engineering, robotics, product, and founder-led execution as one system rather than separate disciplines.

- Work (engineering, robotics, and product case studies): https://mansournia.info/work/
- Research (publications and engineering notes): https://mansournia.info/research/
- Engineering articles: https://mansournia.info/articles/
- Writing (long-form essays and case studies): https://mansournia.info/writing/
- Featured essay, From Pain to Product: One Year Building Acust.ai Across Engineering, Product, and AI: https://mansournia.info/writing/from-pain-to-product/
- Open-source systems: https://mansournia.info/open-source/
- Achievements: https://mansournia.info/achievements/
- Contact: https://mansournia.info/contact/

Note: `/projects/` and its subpaths are legacy URLs that redirect to the equivalent `/work/` pages.
